plainText:
Tate's Solrock (Japanese: フウのソルロック Fu's Solrock) is Tate's main Pokémon in the , , and .

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
Solrock first appeared in It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!. It battled Liza's Lunatone, but it was no match for the Meteorite Pokémon. When Solrock was charging up a , it was interrupted by Lunatone's but still managed to launch the move. However, Lunatone's was stronger and defeated Solrock. It was later seen lifting in the air after freed Max and Tate.

In Solid as a Solrock, Solrock battled alongside Lunatone against Ash's Pikachu and during 's Gym with the twins. It started off with Tackle and then used Solar Beam. However, because of Lunatone's Ice Beam clashing with it, it ruined Tate's strategy and Tate got into an argument with Liza. It left Solrock wide open for Pikachu's . Team Rocket then came by and snatched Solrock and Lunatone from Tate and Liza. They escaped with the help of Ash's Pokémon and sent Team Rocket blasting off with a combined blast.

The battle continued, with Solrock using on Swellow. It dominated Pikachu and Swellow with the help of Lunatone. However, Pikachu's and Swellow's proved to be very powerful. As a result, Solrock was badly beaten by Pikachu's Iron Tail, winning Ash the .

====Personality and characteristics====
Very little is known about Solrock's personality, except for the fact that it usually follows Tate's commands. Unlike its and Lunatone's Trainers, Solrock and Lunatone haven't been known to bicker that much.

====Moves used====
 
 
 
 
 
 

===GOTCHA!===
Tate's Solrock briefly appeared in GOTCHA!.

==In the games==
Solrock appears as Tate's signature Pokémon in every game he is featured in.

===In the core series===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===In spin-off games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====
 
Solrock pairs alongside Tate in Pokémon Masters EX.

 
 

==In the manga==
 ]]
===Pokémon Adventures===
Solrock is Tate's main Pokémon. It was first seen in I'm Always Grumpig First Thing in the Morning II, traveling with its Trainer on Mt. Pyre, where it used its abilities to sense intruders. Solrock was used in conjunction with Lunatone against the s that were aiming to steal the Red and Blue Orbs. Despite their best efforts, the Grunts were only illusions created by Blaise, who easily got past his opponents and stole the orbs.

====Moves used====
 
 
 
 
 

==In the TCG==
 
Solrock appears in the card Tate & Liza (Celestial Storm 148).
 

==Trivia==
In Emerald, Solrock is the only Pokémon from the original team to keep its moveset in the rematches.
Solrock and are the only Pokémon in Pokémon Adventures to have used the move .
